method: Read by eye from film strips; contact from single-frame rows where the ball is visible (about +-0.04 s on the 25 fps clips, +-0.1 s on rola_*), swing peak estimated to about +-0.2 s on shadow swings. Start/end are contact -0.8 s (-1.5 s for serves) and +0.7 s, not individually marked.
notes: Stroke types judged from a small, distant figure; the forehand at 16.5 s is far from the camera.
